name: ekka/alpaca-paper
title: Alpaca paper trading: read the account, place and cancel simulated orders
credential_format: Your Alpaca PAPER key id and secret key joined with a colon, KEYID:SECRET. open.sh joins them for you at a hidden prompt. This row can only reach the paper server; a live key is refused by the kit and would be useless here anyway.

operations.title: Read the paper account: status, cash, buying power
List the open positions in the paper account
Place one simulated day limit order to buy

symbol.description: The stock symbol, for example AAPL. The operator chooses it; nothing here picks a strategy.

qty.description: How many shares, as a whole number in a string, for example "1".

limit_price.description: The most to pay per share, as a decimal in a string, for example "1.00". Below the market price the order sits open until the day ends, which is what a demonstration wants.

client_order_id.description: The kit's own name for this attempt, up to 128 characters. The same id is used again to look the order up, so a lost answer is resolved by asking, never by sending again.

operations.title: Look up one order by the kit's own id for it

client_order_id.description: The client_order_id the order was placed with.

operations.title: Cancel one open order the kit placed

order_id.description: Alpaca's id for the order, from the lookup.
